context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 138 tested the new Accounts role and Finance module. The accounts user (accounts@vhc.in / 12345678) can login and access finance features: Invoices (CRUD + send/mark-paid workflow), Clients (CRUD with invoice protection), Expenses (CRUD with category filtering), Revenue Dashboard (aggregated metrics), Financial Reports (P&L, Aging, GST Summary), and CSV exports. The accounts role also has access to Attendance features (admin-level control). All 21 finance API endpoints are working correctly. Frontend pages render properly with correct navigation, dialogs, and data display.
